note: Original fictional teaching cases. Numerical uncertainty is conditional on the assumptions stated in the articles; constructed validation cases do not constitute a final test set.

regularization.note: Minimize SSE + lambda times sum of squared slopes. The unpenalized intercept is zero. Predictors are centered, orthogonal, and have X transpose X = 4 I.

blocking.note: One illustrated realization of independent fair-coin assignment to two positions in each predeclared batch. Positions are comparable experimental units; no carryover is assumed.
